candidate_text:
The most important thing is that you govern yourselves in a way that reflects the true value of the good news of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you from far away, I will know that you are standing firm, united in one spirit. I will know that you are competing together as one team to stay faithful to the good news.

Do not be intimidated by those who oppose you. Your steadfast courage is a sign of their destruction and your salvation—and this comes from God. For Christ’s sake, you have been given not only the gift of trusting Him but also the gift of suffering for Him. You are facing the same struggle you once saw me face and now hear that I am still facing.

warrant_checker.evidence: No broad commentary layer or unrelated explanatory material is introduced.
Preserves civic force of πολιτεύεσθε but may sound administrative.

communication_readability_checker.evidence: Candidate uses current vocabulary, explicit referents, and manageable sentence structure for the target reader.
Verse 27 is long but coherent; breath-based paragraphing may help oral reading.

discourse_cohesion_checker.evidence: Major logical and rhetorical progression of the source unit remains visible.

theological_risk_checker.evidence: Candidate preserves the difficult claim that suffering for Christ is graciously given, without adding God as explicit subject.

matrix_precedent_checker.evidence: “Stay faithful to the good news” selects a faithfulness-oriented sense and should be logged as a scoped decision.

ambiguity_scope_checker.evidence: Contextual resolution of τῇ πίστει τοῦ εὐαγγελίου; plausible but not the only reading.

checker_independence_note: Procedural role separation only; same assistant environment.
